item.title: £220 'for a cut-up sock' — Apples's new iPhone Pocket ridiculed online
item.description:
📝 In a press release, Apple said the brightly-coloured accessory was part of a limited edition range created in collaboration with the Japanese fashion label Issey Miyake. The late fashion designer previously worked with the tech firm to create the black turtleneck jumpers famously worn by the company's co-founder Steve Jobs. 'Limits of loyalty'The announcement drew criticism on social media, with many suggesting it showed Apple fans would "pay for anything".

item.title: Google will allow users to sideload Android apps without verification
item.description:
📝 Keeping users safe on Android is our top priority. We are designing this flow specifically to resist coercion, ensuring that users aren't tricked into bypassing these safety checks while under pressure from a scammer. Today, we’re excited to start inviting developers to the early access for developer verification in Android Developer Console for developers that distribute exclusively outside of Play, and will share invites to the Play Console experience soon for Play developers.
🔗 Read more: https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2025/11/android-developer-verification-early.html
